title: Noun に 戻ります (Noun ni modorimasu)
shortExplanation: Expresses the action of returning to a previous state, place, or condition.
longExplanation: The Noun に 戻ります grammar point is used to express going back or reverting to a previous state, place, or condition. 戻る (modoru) literally means 'to go back' or 'to revert'. This is often used after a change has occurred, indicating that something is being undone or returned to its original form.

examples.jp: 冷蔵庫に入れると、溶けたアイスクリームは固体に戻ります。
examples.romaji: Reizouko ni ireru to, toketa aisukuriimu wa kotai ni modorimasu.
examples.en: When put in the refrigerator, the melted ice cream returns to its solid state.

examples.jp: 休暇が終わったら、仕事に戻ります。
examples.romaji: Kyuuka ga owattara, shigoto ni modorimasu.
examples.en: When the vacation ends, I will return to work.

examples.jp: リモートワークが終わった後、元のオフィスに戻ります。
examples.romaji: Rimooto waaku ga owatta ato, moto no ofisu ni modorimasu.
examples.en: After remote work is over, we will return to our original office.

examples.jp: 外国で勉強した後、日本に帰ります。
examples.romaji: Gaikoku de benkyou shita ato, Nihon ni kaerimasu.
examples.en: After studying abroad, I will return to Japan.
